# ataila_vm_nodes (Data Source)

The platform's own infrastructure virtual machines, in id order. No address, host or machine id.

Needs `infrastructure-read-global`; never readable with a tenant-scoped token. Platform release 1.0.400 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The platform's own infrastructure VMs (operators only).
data "ataila_vm_nodes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) The nodes, in id order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Virtual CPUs.
- `created_at` (String) When it was recorded (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `description` (String) What it is for.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `environment` (String) Its environment.
- `id` (String) The node's id.
- `name` (String) Its host name.
- `os` (String) Its operating system.
- `ram_gb` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `role` (String) What it runs.
- `status` (String) Its state in the inventory.
- `updated_at` (String) When its record last changed.
